About Max Electric

Serving the Mid-South since 2002
  • Home
  • About Us

Max Electric Inc. was founded by James Kevin Pruitt, and has been providing electrical customer service for residential and light commercial customers since 2003.

As a family owned business, Max Electric Inc. takes pride in our work, and treats our customers like family. We have many repeat customers because of out belief in providing ethical and customer oriented services to every account. Our customers don’t just get an electrician, they will get a drug free, honest, professional team always striving to provide 100% customer satisfaction. Life is busy, so we also offer extended hours to our residential customers at no additional charge.

Top reasons MidSouth customers choose Max Electric for their electrical needs:
  • We only hire trained professionals, who have the skills, knowledge and experience to get your project done at a faster pace and in the most cost-effective manner.
  • Customers who have researched our track record appreciate our 100% Satisfaction Rate.
  • We are licensed, insured and bonded
  • We take safety seriously, and can be trusted to keep your home and family secure.
  • The convenience of our 2 hour appointment slots and Same Day Emergency Service.
  • We are specialized problem solvers and can find and solve problems before they emerge.
  • Finally, Max Electric Inc.'s president ,James Kevin Pruitt, personally guarantees all work or we will return at no cost. We are not satisfied until you are satisfied.

We are 100% satisfaction guaranteed, licensed, bonded and insured in MS and TN.
